response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT o.timespan AS tif, AVG(f.rebrate / NULLIF(f.feerate, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS ord_cnt FROM fees f INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), stats AS (SELECT AVG(ord_cnt) AS mean_cnt FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.avg_ratio) AS avg_of_avg_ratios, SUM(g.ord_cnt) AS total_distinct_orders, AVG(g.ord_cnt - s.mean_cnt) AS avg_excess_count FROM g CROSS JOIN stats s WHERE g.ord_cnt > s.mean_cnt;

assumptions.assumption: 'Average of rebrate / feerate' is the mean of the per-fee-row ratio, with rows whose rebrate is NULL or whose feerate is NULL or 0 excluded (NULLIF guards against division by zero).
Orders with a NULL timespan form their own group, since GROUP BY keeps NULL as a group.
The cross-group average count is the unweighted mean of the per-group distinct-order counts.
Fees are joined to orders with an inner join, so fees whose orderslink has no matching order are dropped, as the request specifies.

alternatives.interpretation: The ratio is taken between the group averages instead: the average rebrate divided by the average feerate within each group, with NULL or zero feerates ignored.
alternatives.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT o.timespan AS tif, AVG(f.rebrate) / NULLIF(AVG(f.feerate), 0) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS ord_cnt FROM fees f INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), stats AS (SELECT AVG(ord_cnt) AS mean_cnt FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.avg_ratio) AS avg_of_avg_ratios, SUM(g.ord_cnt) AS total_distinct_orders, AVG(g.ord_cnt - s.mean_cnt) AS avg_excess_count FROM g CROSS JOIN stats s WHERE g.ord_cnt > s.mean_cnt;

alternatives.interpretation: Orders with a NULL time in force are excluded entirely, so they form no group and do not affect the cross-group average.
alternatives.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT o.timespan AS tif, AVG(f.rebrate / NULLIF(f.feerate, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS ord_cnt FROM fees f INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE o.timespan IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.timespan), stats AS (SELECT AVG(ord_cnt) AS mean_cnt FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.avg_ratio) AS avg_of_avg_ratios, SUM(g.ord_cnt) AS total_distinct_orders, AVG(g.ord_cnt - s.mean_cnt) AS avg_excess_count FROM g CROSS JOIN stats s WHERE g.ord_cnt > s.mean_cnt;
